display.purpose: Page titles — one per page (Feed ao vivo, Regras, Saúde…).

label.purpose: Metadata lines, table headers, form field labels — always muted.

shadows.name: capsule-float
shadows.purpose: The navigation capsule only — the one element that must read as physically hovering.

shadows.name: glass-lift
shadows.purpose: Every glass card — a softer lift so cards rest on the canvas rather than float above it.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Nav pill slide between tabs — smooth deceleration, no bounce/overshoot (replaced an elastic curve flagged by the S4-09 finish pass).

motion.name: diagonal-reveal
motion.purpose: Page transition on tab click — a custom diagonal reveal replacing the browser's default cross-fade.

motion.name: fill-from-click
motion.purpose: Primary button fill bloom expanding from the pointer-down point (useFillOrigin).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA (Nova regra, Nova fonte, Novo destinatário, Salvar, Entrar) — capsule-black fill with a click-point fill bloom.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; background: #17181c; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); clip-path: circle(0% at var(--fill-x, 50%) var(--fill-y, 50%)); transition: clip-path 480ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:active::after { clip-path: circle(150% at var(--fill-x, 50%) var(--fill-y, 50%)); }

components.name: Primary Button (disabled)
components.description: Submit button with an unmet precondition (empty password, no recipient selected) — explicit gray fill, not opacity dimming.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Table row actions (Editar, Duplicar, Testar) — white fill, hairline border, muted text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12); background: #fff; cursor: pointer; color: #4b4b52; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f0f0f2; }

components.name: Danger Ghost Button
components.description: Delete action (Excluir) — same ghost shape, danger-colored text and border. Always paired with the word Excluir, never icon-only.

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Dot + word status indicator — never color-only. Pale tint background, saturated dot and text of the same hue.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-status__dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-status--success { background: #e2f5e9; color: #1c8a4b; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Frosted translucent container — match cards, CRUD panels, table wraps, the login card. Needs a varied background behind it (Aurora Wash) to read as glass.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(15, 15, 20, 0.08); padding: 20px; }

components.name: Navigation Capsule
components.description: Floating dark pill-shaped nav with a gooey sliding active-tab pill (SVG goo filter) and diagonal View Transitions page reveals.
components.css: .ds-nav-capsule { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #17181c; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); } .ds-nav-tab { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; color: #b8b9bf; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-tab--active { background: #fff; color: #08060d; }

components.name: Mobile Table Row (card-stack)
components.description: Below 640px, CRUD table rows become stacked label/value cards instead of a scrolling table, so actions stay directly reachable.
components.css: .ds-mobile-row { padding: 12px; box-sizing: border-box; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); } .ds-mobile-row__field { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 6px 0; } .ds-mobile-row__label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #4b4b52; }

narrative.overview: teleyes is a one-admin instrument panel for a personal Telegram promotion monitor: liquid glass in daylight, never a nightclub. The world is Apple's liquid-glass material — a light, almost-white canvas holding frosted, translucent surfaces — applied in Operate mode: the interface's job is to let Gabriel scan a live feed, edit rules, and check system health quickly, never to perform for an audience. Every screen is real: real login, real CRUD, real SSE feed, real (or honestly not_configured) notification delivery. Legibility is a stated, non-negotiable acceptance criterion: product name and price are always the darkest, heaviest thing in a row; status is never color alone. The one deliberately theatrical gesture — the floating dark navigation capsule with its gooey sliding pill and diagonal page transitions — exists precisely because it is the one piece of chrome Gabriel looks at on every single screen.
keyCharacteristics: Light liquid-glass surfaces on an off-white canvas, never a dark theme.
A floating dark capsule is the only saturated, opaque shape in the whole system.
Weight and color encode hierarchy (product/price bold+dark, metadata light+gray) — never size alone.
Status is always a dot plus a word, never a color chip by itself.
Motion is confined to specific, purposeful moments (nav pill, page transition, button fill) and fully disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Dark Shape Rule
rules.body: Only the navigation capsule (and, by inheritance, primary buttons using its same fill) is ever a flat, opaque dark shape.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: A row never needs a third font size to read correctly: what matters is bold and dark, what's context is regular and muted.

rules.name: The Two-Shadow Rule
rules.body: There are exactly two shadow values in the whole system (capsule float, glass lift). A third shadow value is a sign a new component invented its own physics.

rules.name: The Dot-and-Word Rule
rules.body: No status anywhere in the system is color-only — every status resolves to a {label, color} pair rendered as dot + word together.

dos: Do keep product and price the darkest, boldest thing in any row.
Do pair every status indicator with a word, never a bare colored dot or chip.
Do wrap every new primary CTA in .fill-button and call useFillOrigin() on onPointerDown.
Do guard every new motion with a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce override that removes it, not just shortens it.
Do surface the backend's real error detail string in role="alert" text.
donts: Don't introduce a second dark, opaque fill anywhere outside the navigation capsule and primary buttons.
Don't invent a third shadow value.
Don't fabricate data a real field doesn't back.
Don't use a bounce/elastic easing curve anywhere — the system's one motion signature uses a smooth exponential decelerate.
